negative_findings.description: No dedicated Hungarian-language LinkedIn-based or company-announcement aggregator surfaced that can be collected lawfully at scale. LinkedIn company pages of MNB, GIRO, OTP, Euronet and the HU PSPs are the natural weak-signal channel for hiring and partnership posts, but LinkedIn's ToS and authentication wall make programmatic collection non-viable and no compliant mirror was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned no HU LinkedIn aggregator or open API mirror; LinkedIn itself is auth-walled and ToS-restricted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A significant fraction of HU payments weak signals (role changes, project go-lives, partnership posts) appear first on LinkedIn and will be missed by web-only collection.

negative_findings.description: No speaker list or detailed agenda could be obtained for the Budapest TechShow X (merged PayTechShow/BankTechShow) edition from the aggregator page found; the aggregator described tracks but did not name speakers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Track topics described (cards, instant payments/AFR, POS, softPOS, acquiring, ISO 20022, IPR) but no named speakers; organiser's own domain not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The speaker list is the actual intelligence asset (who is building what); without it the event is only a calendar entry.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian equivalent of a structured startup-funding database (Crunchbase-style, HU-specific, open) was found for payment/fintech rounds. Funding signals are scattered across trade press (FinTechZone), general media (Infostart, Piac&Profit) and investor sites.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only narrative media coverage and investor-side pages; no structured HU funding dataset located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Funding-round tracking will require entity extraction from prose rather than a clean feed, raising cost and error rate.

negative_findings.description: Profession.hu and hu.indeed.com were observed only through search-result summaries in this pass; their robots.txt, rate limits and anti-bot posture were not tested. Job boards commonly return 403 to automated clients.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fetch attempted/confirmed; access status recorded as unverified rather than blocked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring signal is a core part of this cell; if these boards block automation the workstream needs a manual or licensed-feed fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Professional-network channel (LinkedIn company pages and personal posts of MNB/GIRO/bank payment executives) is unaddressed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide policy explicitly: either a manual analyst watchlist of ~30 named HU payments people/organisations reviewed weekly, or a licensed social-listening feed. Do not attempt scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor/ISO side of the HU POS and ATM market (terminal suppliers, ATM maintainers, payment software integrators, cash-in-transit firms) was not systematically enumerated; only Euronet was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the supplier map from conference sponsor/exhibitor lists (TechShow X, Portfolio Financial IT), TED/EKR award notices, and bank ATM-migration notices; then monitor each vendor's HU newsroom and career page.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian domestic procurement register (EKR / Közbeszerzési Értesítő) was inferred as relevant but not directly located or profiled in this pass; only the EU-level TED notice was seen.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Profile ekr.gov.hu and the Közbeszerzési Értesítő search interface, test CPV/keyword filtering for POS, ATM and card-acceptance contracts, and register it as a separate candidate source.

coverage_gaps.description: Awards coverage is limited to the Mastercard Év Bankja programme; other HU/CEE award schemes that surface payment projects (e.g. IT/innovation and e-commerce awards, CEE-level fintech awards) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sweep for further HU award programmes with payment/innovation categories and add their submission and winner pages to the register.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference and award sources are annual/episodic; archived past editions (agendas, slide decks) were not harvested, so no historical baseline exists for detecting what is genuinely new.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill 3-5 years of Portfolio, FinTechShow/TechShow and Év Bankja agendas and winner lists to build a change-detection baseline.

brief: Hungary's payments weak-signal landscape is unusually concentrated: a handful of Hungarian-language hubs — Portfolio.hu's conference arm, FinTechZone (which also runs the FinTechShow/TechShow event brand), the Mastercard Év Bankja awards and the MNB's Fizetési Rendszer Fórum — carry most of the forward-looking disclosure, with named MNB, GIRO and bank executives repeatedly presenting transaction volumes and roadmap dates on stage well before official statistics appear. Infrastructure and operator sites (GIRO plus its career portal, Euronet's ATM newsroom, bank ATM-migration notices) and public procurement notices for card acceptance and POS services supply the hardest quantitative early signals, while job boards (Profession, Indeed, Jooble) reveal acquiring, POS and instant-payment build programmes through vacancy text. Funding and market-entry signals exist but only as scattered prose across trade and general media — there is no structured Hungarian funding dataset. The main uncovered channel is LinkedIn, which is where much of this community announces first and which cannot be collected compliantly at scale; the vendor/ISO layer of the POS and ATM market also still needs systematic enumeration.
